content: Bibu nnɛwɑ Isɑkɑri u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Tolɑ, kɑ Puɑ, kɑ Yɑsubu, kɑ Simuroni.

Tolɑn bibɑ Usi, kɑ Refɑyɑ, kɑ Yeriɛli kɑ Yɑmɑi, kɑ Yibisɑmu, kɑ sere Sɑmuɛli. Berɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ wiruɡibu ben yɛnusɔ, Tolɑn bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔruɡɔbɑ ben wɑɑti ye sɔɔ. Dɑfidin wɑɑti sɔɔ, ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ yiru kɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ (22.600).
Usin biiwɑ Yisirɑyɑ. Yisirɑyɑ kɑ win bibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ be wiruɡibu nɔɔbu. Win bii berɑ Mikɑɛli, kɑ Abudiɑsi, kɑ Yoɛli, kɑ Yisiyɑ.
Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ be sɑnnu, tɔn kurɔbu kɑ bibu bɑ dɑbi sere bɑ koo kpĩ bu tɔn durɔbu nɔrɔbun subɑ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ (36.000) wɑ be sɔɔ be bɑ koo kpĩ bu tɑbu ko.
Isɑkɑrin bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ, be bɑ tireru doke, ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ wɛnɛ kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (87.000). Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔruɡɔbɑ.
Bɛnyɑmɛɛ kɑ Nɛfitɑlin
bibun bweseru
Bibu itɑwɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Belɑ, kɑ Bekɛɛ, kɑ Yediɛli.

Bibu nɔɔbuwɑ Belɑ u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Ɛsiboni, kɑ Usi, kɑ Usiɛli, kɑ Yerimɔti, kɑ mɑɑ Iri. Ben bɑɑwure u sɑ̃ɑwɑ win bwese kɛrɑn wiruɡii. Be kpuro mɑɑ wɔruɡɔbɑrɑ. Bɑ bu tireru doke mɑ ben ɡeerɑ kuɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ yiru kɑ tɔmbu tɛnɑ kɑ nnɛ (22.034).
Bekɛɛn bibɑ Semirɑ, kɑ Yoɑsi, kɑ Ɛliesɛɛ, kɑ Elionɑi, kɑ Omiri, kɑ Yeremɔti, kɑ Abiyɑ, kɑ Anɑtɔtu, kɑ Alɑmɛti. Beni kpurowɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Bekɛɛn bibu.
Mɑ bɑ bu tireru doke nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ swĩinɛ bwese kɛrɑ ye sɔɔ. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɛnu yɛ̃ro wɔruɡɔbɑ. Mɑ ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔnu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu kɑ ɡoobu (20.200).
Yediɛlin biiwɑ Bilihɑni. Bilihɑnin bibɑ mɑɑ Yeusi, kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ, kɑ Ehudu, kɑ Kenɑɑnɑ, kɑ Setɑni, kɑ Tɑɑsisi, kɑ sere Akisɑsɑɑ.

Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yediɛlin bibun bweseru. Be kpuro mɑɑ wɔruɡɔbɑrɑ. Mɑ ben bɑɑwure u sɑ̃ɑ wiruɡii win bwese kɛrɑ sɔɔ. Ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ yiru, kɑ tɔmbu ɡoobu (17.200) be bɑ koo kpĩ bu tɑbu ko.
Supimu kɑ Hupimu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Irin bibu. Mɑ Husimu u mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Akɛɛn bii.
Nɛfitɑlin bibɑ Yɑsiɛli, kɑ Guni, kɑ Yesɛɛ, kɑ sere Sɑlumu. Beni kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Bilihɑn nikurɔminu.
Mɑnɑsen bibun bweseru
Bii be Mɑnɑse u kɑ win kurɔ Siriɡii mɑrɑ, berɑ Asiriɛli kɑ Mɑkiri wi u sɑ̃ɑ Gɑlɑdin tundo.
Mɑkiri wiyɑ u Hupimu kɑ Supimu kurɔbu suɑ. Win sesun yĩsirɑ Mɑɑkɑ. Win bii yirusen yĩsirɑ Selofɑdi. Bii tɔn kurɔbɑ Selofɑdi wi, u mɑrɑ.
Mɑɑkɑ, Mɑkirin kurɔ u bii tɔn durɔ mɑrɑ mɑ bɑ nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ Perɛsi. U mɑɑ wure u bii tɔn durɔ mɑrɑ mɑ bɑ nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ Serɛsi. Serɛsi wiyɑ u Ulɑmu kɑ Rekɛmu mɑrɑ.
Ulɑmun biiwɑ Bedɑni. Beniwɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gɑlɑdi, Mɑkirin bii, Mɑnɑsen debubun bibun bweseru.
Hɑmɔlekɛti, Gɑlɑdin sesuwɑ u Isodu kɑ Abiesɛɛ kɑ Mɑlɑ mɑrɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Semidɑn bibu, berɑ Akiyɑni kɑ Sikɛmu kɑ Likisi kɑ sere Aniɑmu.
Efɑrɑimun bibun bweseru
Efɑrɑimun bibun bweseru wee. Efɑrɑimu u Sutelɑki mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sutelɑki u Berɛdi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Berɛdi u Tɑhɑti mɑrɑ. Mɑ Tɑhɑti u Eleɑdɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Eleɑdɑ u Tɑhɑti mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Tɑhɑti u Sɑbɑdi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sɑbɑdi u Sutelɑki mɑrɑ. Efɑrɑimu u mɑɑ bibu yiru mɑrɑ, Sutelɑki bɑɑsi, beyɑ Esɛɛ kɑ Eleɑdi. Berɑ bɑ Gɑtiɡibu wɔri bu kɑ sibun yɑɑ sɑbenu mwɑ. Adɑmɑ Gɑtiɡii be, sibɑ bu ɡo.
Mɑ Efɑrɑimu u ɡɔɔ wooru sinɑ n kɑ tɛ. Mɑ win mɛro bisibu bɑ nɑ bɑ nùn nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ.
Yen biruwɑ u kɑ win kurɔ mɛnnɑ, mɑ u ɡurɑ suɑ u bii tɔn durɔ mɑrɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ Beriɑ yèn sɔ̃ u nuku sɑnkirɑnu wɑ win yɛnuɔ.
U mɑɑ bii tɔn kurɔ mɑrɑ wi bɑ mɔ̀ Serɑki. Wiyɑ u Bɛti Horoni bɑnɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɔwɑɔ, kɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡunɡuru wɔllɔ, kɑ mɑɑ Usɛni Seerɑ.
Mɑ Beriɑ wi, u seewɑ u Refɑ mɑrɑ. Mɑ Refɑ u seewɑ u Resɛfu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Resɛfu u seewɑ u Telɑki mɑrɑ. Mɑ Telɑki u seewɑ u Tɑkɑni mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Tɑkɑni u seewɑ u Lɑdɑni mɑrɑ. Mɑ Lɑdɑni u seewɑ u Amihudu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Amihudu u seewɑ u Elisɑmɑ mɑrɑ.
Mɑ Elisɑmɑ u seewɑ u Nuni mɑrɑ. Mɑ Nuni u seewɑ u Yosue mɑrɑ.

Tem mɛ bɑ wɑ bɑ sinɑ mɛyɑ Betɛli kɑ yen wuu si su kɑ ye sikerenɛ. Siyɑ Nɑɑrɑni ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ kɑ Gesɛɛ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnu, kɑ Sikɛmu kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnu, n kɑ ɡirɑri Gɑsɑɔ kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnɔ.

Tem mɛ Mɑnɑsen bibun bweserɑ wɑ, mɛyɑ Bɛti Seɑni kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnu, kɑ Tɑɑnɑki kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnu, kɑ Mɛɡido kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnu, kɑ sere Dori kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnu. Wuu si sɔɔrɑ Yosɛfu, Isirelin biin bibun bweserɑ sinɑ.
Asɛɛn bibun bweseru
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Asɛɛn bibu, berɑ Yiminɑ kɑ Yisifɑ kɑ Yisifi kɑ Beriɑ kɑ sere ben sesu Serɑki.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Beriɑn bibu, berɑ Hebɛɛ kɑ Mɑɑkiɛli. Mɑɑkiɛli wiyɑ u wuu ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Biisɑfiti swĩi.
Hebɛɛwɑ u Yɑfilɛti mɑrɑ kɑ Somɛɛ kɑ Hotɑmu kɑ sere ben sesu Suɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yɑfilɛtin bibu, berɑ Pɑsɑki kɑ Bimɑli kɑ sere Asifɑti. Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yɑfilɛtin bibu, berɑ mi.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sɑmɛɛn bibu, berɑ Aki kɑ Roɡɑ kɑ Hubɑ kɑ sere Arɑmu.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ win wɔnɔ Helɛmun bibu, berɑ Sofɑki kɑ Yiminɑ kɑ Selɛsi kɑ sere Amɑli.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sofɑkin bibu, berɑ Suɑ kɑ Hɑɑnɛfɛɛ kɑ Suɑli kɑ Beri kɑ Yimurɑ,
kɑ Beseri kɑ Hɔdu kɑ Sɑmmɑ kɑ Silisɑ kɑ Yitirɑni kɑ sere Beerɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yetɛɛn bibu, berɑ Yɛfunɛ kɑ Pisipɑ kɑ sere Arɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Ulɑn bibu, berɑ Arɑ kɑ Hɑniɛli kɑ sere Risiɑ.

Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Asɛɛn bibun bweseru, berɑ mi. Ben bɑɑwure u sɑ̃ɑwɑ wiruɡii win berɑɔ. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔruɡɔbɑ. Be bɑ tireru doke, ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu kɑ tiɑ (26.000) be, be bɑ koo kpĩ bu tɑbu ko.
Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bwese kɛrɑɡii
be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ
